head: 41560a09f6a20405984691ce885da3e112928a7c
summary: A supported candidate whose Kev verdict is not_real no longer counts as a vulnerability in benchmark scores, the review report, or the lgtm review exit code. The judge-eval report measures Kev verdict and support accuracy and judge-agent agreement separately against blind model labels for the Shoply candidates, listing stale and undetermined units and quote absence.
pending_integration: Real-world parts of AC-S6-1 and AC-S6-2, and AC-S6-6 (INTEGRATE)
Regenerate tests/model_input_lock/expected.json after the final merge
outstanding: final-01: run6-final records have no `mode` key, so live rejudge in benchmark/judge_eval.py skips them; Kev measures are n=0 on a live rerun until it defaults to `lgtm`.
final-02: 7 of 8 undetermined units (sqli_*/2.0) likely fail only an exact quote match; relabel them and loosen the criteria sentence.
final-03: `safe_case_acceptance` counts a supported-but-not_real unit as accepted, against DEC-7.
Structure M1: the not_real rule is written separately in src/lgtm/cli.py, src/lgtm/reporting/report_builder.py, benchmark/evaluate.py.
Security SEC-1: a not_real suppression of exit 1 is not visible in report.json (kev_verdict omitted); SEC-2: the cli.py guard also drops baseline vulnerable findings carrying not_real.
Test quality M1-M3: quote_absence edge cases, report not_real count and fix suppression, and stale handling through report() are not asserted.
Labeling judgment: manager-gated authz listing/bulk claims labeled not_real without manager-visibility policy text.
